notes.title: Hotfix: 1.52
notes.content: -Fixed a rare issue causing the game to crash sometimes when Steam user details couldn't be retrieved for leaderboard integration.

notes.title: Minor Patch Notes: 1.51
notes.content: Fixed issues with the Daily Challenge leaderboards not sharing scores. Caused by an update in the GameMaker Steamworks SDK plugin changing how leaderboard functions work. Have downgraded the plugin version to fix.

notes.title: Major Update: Level Editor
notes.content:
[b]Fool's End LEVEL EDITOR is out now![/b]

Use the full Fool's End kit set and mechanic pieces to make and play your own levels.

[b]Key tools (Left Click / R2/ RT to use)[/b]
[list]
[*] Pencil / Create: Use this to place tiles, enemies, and other mechanics throughout the levels. 
[*] Eraser: Destroys the selected tile. Can be used at any point by right clicking (or L2/LT).
[*] Damager: Damages the tile as if the player had lightly mined it.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44695780/649711092c58936cefd7e88d7505f422b34444d4.gif[/img]

The level editor is fully compatible with Gamepads, Steam Deck and Keyboard/mouse setups.

Check out a full video tutorial of how to use the Level Editor:

[previewyoutube=II9WI8Bc-ms;full][/previewyoutube]



At the moment you are able to share levels on Steam but not quite download and play other people's levels. [b]That is the next step.[/b]

notes.title: Minor Patch Notes: 1.21
notes.content:

notes.title: Update: 1.20
notes.content:
The biggest changes in this update are to the Daily Challenge mode. Some other little but long-requested features are packed in here too.

[u][b]Daily Challenge Algorithm Update:[/b][/u]
--Fatsploders added to daily rotation.
--Firesnakes added to daily rotation.
--Patrol towers added to daily rotation.
--Fireball shooters positioning reworked.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44695780/a1f6bdc3d72fbc6f459a55198805e6fbcff60196.gif[/img]

[u][b]Stat changes:[/b][/u]
-Dirt and other gravity affected tiles now fall more slowly (gravity turned down from 0.6 to 0.2 for those tiles)
-Player gravity remains.

[u][b]Fixes:[/b][/u]
-Jumping after hanging is now much smoother (this was a common complaint, and took quite a while to resolve).

Fixes in progress:
-Beer collectibles sometimes do not save properly. I'm hoping this patch resolves it but it is hard to test on my end so will need to see results since patch pushed.

[u][b]Coming soon:[/b][/u]
-Level editor.
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44695780/bef969c6e833c84825ea0b0ec06e1de2bafe615d.gif[/img]

--It's nearly complete, just polishing off some UI features and making sure all tiles/enemies work together in the editor as intended.
--Steam Workshop integration for publishing levels is the last step.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44695780/f82bbd0d3970d431aa3539d8c0960fe9ef45afea.gif[/img]

notes.title: Patch Notes: 1.13
notes.content:
[b]Daily Challenge:[/b]
-Fixed an ongoing issue which would cause scores not to register on the Daily Challenge Leaderboard. There are still some complications with Steamworks that requires you to open the Leaderboard in the Main Menu to see your score on the Leaderboard.

[b]Other:[/b]
-The text rendering on the Main Menu is improved when players return to the menu after playing the game.

notes.title: Patch Notes: 1.12
notes.content:
It's been a few weeks, but we've got some nice little changes today.

[b]Gameplay:[/b]
-Pickaxe can now be thrown in a one block high corridor without hitting the roof or floor.
-Level timers increased on level Ossuary 9, 4 & 7.
-Gargoyle now displays the correct biome sprite when destroyed.

[b]Daily Challenge:[/b]
-Fireball shooters added to Jungle levels (will cause chaos).
-Variation added to some of the level creation.

notes.title: Hotfix: 1.11a
notes.content: -Fixed a bug that prevents playing the main game levels if you play a Daily Challenge level before the main levels.

notes.title: Patch Notes: 1.11
notes.content:
Some minor additions to Daily Challenges, UI, and general quality of life improvements:
[list]
[*]Players can now restart any level by pausing the game and choosing to 'Restart'
[*]There's now a small chance that Rats will appear on top of dirt blocks in a Daily Challenge.
[*]Colour of Mines is now changed in Cave-based Daily Challenges to be more clearly distinguishable. Previously was hard to spot mines in Caves biomes, as mines don't appear until the later Jungle levels in the core game. The mines art remains the same for Jungle and Ossuary levels.
[*]Spikes are now destroyed by the pickaxe at the correct frame of contact. 
[*]Ctrl key (left and right) now make the player drop while hanging. B (circle) remains the default drop key for gamepad users.
[*]Players can now drop slightly quicker when going into a ledge-hang (should reduce occasions when a JUMP key press is ignored).
[*]Walk/run toggle preferences are now saved across play sessions.
[*]The game will continuously try to upload user scores to the Daily Challenge Leaderboard if score uploading fails to connect to Steam.
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix: 1.10b
notes.content:
-Added Leaderboard as an option to the main menu.
-Fixed issue where the Leaderboard wasn't showing more than once per session.

notes.title: Hotfix: 1.10a
notes.content: -When gold coins and gems are obtained in Daily Challenge mode, the score shakes in the top right corner.

notes.title: Daily Challenges out now - Fool’s End version 1.10
notes.content:
Daily Challenge is out now!

Each day one new level is generated for players across the world to complete and compete in.
-Players gain points when playing the Daily Challenge by picking up gold and gems from the ground.
-After completing the challenge, your score is calculated and compared to other players.
-The player’s with the top 5 scores for each day go onto a leaderboard, visible on the Steam Community page and in-game.
-The Daily Challenge and its respective leaderboard reset each day and are tied the user’s local time/date.

To mark this new content update, I've also added a new achievement for players to earn:
[list]
[*] Gems and other shiny things:  Complete your first Daily Challenge.
[/list]

Some other fixes have been made in this patch too, including:
Gameplay fixes:
-Smash attack shouldn’t trigger when tiles above and to the side are falling (this now prevents player from mining and getting pulled toward an enemy where the game thinks you’re attacking).
-Rare crashable error with enemies converted to stone is now resolved.

notes.title: Patch Notes: 1.08
notes.content:
Hmmm, bigger number but not a very exciting update for y'all unfortunately.

Behind the scenes I've updated the project from running on a 2022 version of GameMaker's LTS engine, to now the most up-to-date version of GameMaker. Some things broke in the process and have since been resolved, but ultimately it has been worth it enable some more cool stuff that I've got cooking.

So, for some more behind-the-scenes insights:
-Daily Level Challenges:
[list]
[*]Procedural level gen is working perfectly, just needs a little balancing and that side of it is ready.
[*]Still working on integrating Steam Leaderboards into the Daily Level Challenge.
[*]All 3 biomes will be able to generated in the Daily Level prod gen algorithm.
[/list]
-Linux version:
[list]
[*]Testing on Steam Deck shortly, as Steam Deck optimization and Linux build update will push on the same day.
[/list]

And...I have one last question for anyone still reading. I started seeing some pixel distortion in the game after updating my AMD graphics drivers to the latest release. I've since rolled back to the Nov. 2023 drivers and had 0 issues, but was just wondering if anybody else with an AMD graphics card was having issues with pixel distortion in the game?

notes.title: Hotfix: 1.07c
notes.content:
-More sound effects added for the snake enemy.
-Minor stability improvements.

notes.title: Hotfix: 1.07a
notes.content:
-Fixed an issue that would sometimes prevent the achievement "Mr. Diggs" from being earned. Now players who have mined 1000+ dirt tiles will get the achievement next time they complete a level.
-New minor metallic ring sound effect added when mining rock-based tiles.

notes.title: Fool's End Roadmap 2024
notes.content:
There's more mining mayhem to come.

Here's what's planned for the rest of the year:

[b][u]Q2 / Soon:[/u][/b]
[list]
[*][b][i]Daily Challenge Levels[/i][/b]: Every 24 hours, players will be presented with a randomly generated level. The players who can finish the level with the fewest deaths and in the quickest time will go to the top of a daily leaderboard.
[*]Linux version: Hoping to get a native Linux version built soon, with the goal of optimizing for Steam Deck use.
[*]Customisable Gravestones: Choose between a selection of gravestones to express yourself a little bit.
[*]Vultures Update: More content, including vultures (to say the least).
[/list]
[b][u][i]Q3/Q4:[/i][/u][/b]
[list]
[*][b][i]Level Editor[/i][/b]: The big one. A fully-fledged level editor so anyone can make and share their own levels. It will take a while to polish and get working properly so won't be ready until later in the year.
[/list]
[u][b][i]Ongoing:[/i][/b][/u]
[list]
[*]Weekly updates and fixes will keep rolling out where necessary.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes: 1.07
notes.content:
Hello again.

Aside from the brand new cover art and logo redesign, there's been a couple more changes to the game:

-Pickaxe attacks on enemies have been improved. The player now locks onto the closest enemy when attacking.
-VFX added to highlight the impact of player attacks on enemies (when locked on).
-Sound added when player swings axe at enemy.
-New animation variant for player attacks on enemies.
-New logo featured in main menu.
-New addition to credits thanking GameMaker.

notes.content:

-The level layout on Jungle 10 has been modified to add more explosions and reduce gargoyle stoning.
-Music track has been changed and sped up on Jungle 10 to make the level more hectic.

notes.title: Patch Notes: 1.05

Game roadmap to be announced in the coming days.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.03
notes.content:
[i]Some important fixes here[/i]

[b]Gameplay notes:[/b]
-HANGING DROP TIMER now prevents player from accidentally dropping for 10 frames when they first start hanging and press (or pre-press) jump.
-Falling TNT cannot be mined straight away, giving the player 2 seconds of TNT explosion immunity upon a TNT's change of location.

[b]Other:[/b]
-Time trial saving error fixed! Now the game ALWAYS successfully saves completed time trials and displays them correctly in the Level Select menu once completed.
-Time trials are always rounded to the nearest second. If you finish a time trial at the same second as the PAR TIME, it will now [b]always [/b]count as a success.
